title: Brazil Star Neymar Announces International Retirement: 'It Is Now Over'
facts: Neymar announced his retirement from international football following Brazil's 2-1 loss to Norway in the World Cup round of 16. [cite: 478]
Neymar finishes his international career as the top goalscorer in the history of the Brazilian men's national team. [cite: 479]
Neymar scored 80 goals in 129 appearances for the Brazilian men's national team. [cite: 479]
Neymar made his senior international debut for Brazil in 2010. [cite: 480]
Neymar appeared in four World Cup tournaments during his international career. [cite: 480]
Neymar competed in two Olympic tournaments for Brazil. [cite: 481]
Neymar won a silver medal with Brazil at the 2012 Olympic tournament. [cite: 481]
Neymar helped lead the Brazilian national team to a gold medal at the 2016 Olympics. [cite: 481]
Neymar made two substitute appearances for Brazil at the 2026 World Cup. [cite: 481]
Neymar scored his only goal of the 2026 World Cup from a penalty kick in stoppage time against Norway. [cite: 482]
Neymar made a substitute appearance in the second half of Brazil's group stage match against Scotland. [cite: 482]
Thierry Henry praised Neymar's overall career on the FOX Sports program "World Cup Today". [cite: 483, 484]
Zlatan Ibrahimović publicly commended Neymar's football career following the retirement announcement. [cite: 490]
Zlatan Ibrahimović noted that people wanted Neymar to win the Ballon d'Or but he did not achieve it. [cite: 491]
Norway advanced to the World Cup quarterfinals to face the winner of the match between Mexico and England. [cite: 492]
